name: 75068 · Little Elm, TX
findings: ZIP 75068 (Little Elm) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75068 (Little Elm) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 75068 (Little Elm) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
